preservation.method: Only generated dark charcoal/red-ochre pigment composited over the original rock; no pixel brightened. Strengthened the retained pigment after the first visual review found it too faint.

prompt: Two bent charcoal reeds lean toward each other with a worn red-ochre pebble between them; primitive earth pigment on pale stone; no text, hands, other figures or symbols. Only new pigment retained on vacant upper-right rock.
visual_review: Inspected final PNG and decoded 512px JPEG: recognizable Pepe with broad mouth and heavy-lidded eyes, both inherited hands have four fingers and one thumb. No new hands. Charcoal bent reeds and ochre stone added on upper-right rock. No letters, numbers, logos, watermark, border, real people or prohibited symbols observed.
limitations: Local visual review is not independent certification. Conservative name screen is not every filesystem equivalence rule.
The small worn motif is more legible in the PNG; JPEG reduction softens its fine strokes.
